production.note: US model years. First: Cars.com (a database) lists the '2023 Maserati Grecale' 'Trofeo AWD'; Maserati North America, 18 January 2023: the Grecale is 'now available to test-drive and purchase at Maserati showrooms across North America' (stellantis-grecale-na-on-sale). Still on sale: Edmunds (Kyle Patrick, 18 June 2026) on the 2027 Grecale: "The Trofeo remains the ICE range-topper" (edmunds-2027-maserati-update).

displacementL.note: 3,000 cc as printed ('Displacement 1995 cc | 1995 cc | 3000 cc', GT / Modena / Trofeo); the US table gives '3.0L' (stellantis-grecale-techdata). Maserati's GranTurismo table gives the same Nettuno V6 as 2,992 cc.

fuel.note: The Trofeo V6 has no mild-hybrid system (the four-cylinder GT and Modena are 'L4 MHEV with BSG').

drivetrain.note: 'Four-wheel drive with limited slip self-locking electronic rear differential': a permanent all-wheel-drive system.

powerHp.note: Quote (US and Canada technical table, columns Trofeo / Modena / GT): "Peak output (hp): 523 hp @ 6500 rpm | 325 hp @ 5750 rpm | 296 hp @ 5750 rpm". Maserati NA's on-sale release: '523-hp V6, derived from the MC20 Nettuno engine' (stellantis-grecale-na-on-sale). European rating 530 CV ('Max. power output 300 CV | 330 CV | 530 CV', maserati-grecale-catalogue); 530 x 0.98632 = 523 hp.

weightLb.note: Quote (US and Canada technical table, columns Trofeo / Modena / GT): "Homologated weight (lbs) 4,629 4,431 4,431". The European table gives 'Homologated weight (kg) 2,027 1,895 1,870' (2,027 kg = 4,469 lb). Kelley Blue Book (a database) also lists the 2023 Trofeo at "Curb Weight | 4629 pounds" (kbb-grecale-2023-specs); Cars.com (a database) lists "Base Curb Weight 4,469 lbs", which is the European kg figure converted (carscom-grecale-trofeo-2023). Maserati labels the US figure 'homologated weight', not 'curb weight'; see reviewNotes.

discrepancies.reason: Market: 4,629 lb is Maserati's US and Canada homologated weight; 4,469 lb (Cars.com) is Maserati's European homologated weight of 2,027 kg converted.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 4,629 lb, the manufacturer's US figure, which Kelley Blue Book also lists.

reviewNotes: Maserati's US table labels 4,629 lb 'Homologated weight (lbs)', not 'curb weight'. It is the only US weight Maserati publishes for the Grecale Trofeo and is a precise figure (not an upper limit as with the MC20), so it is used at weight step 1. An owner should confirm that a Maserati 'homologated weight' is accepted as a curb weight.
